<function name="SetPlace" parent="CNavArea" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Sets the Place of the nav area.

There is a limit of 256 unique places per `.nav` file.
	</description>
	<realm>Server</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="place" type="string">Set to `""` to remove place from the nav area. There's a limit of 255 characters.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Returns true of operation succeeded, false otherwise.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
